nodes.body:
Hi @BBuf, adding downstream CI evidence for this fixture correction, which has blocked two of my otherwise unrelated PRs. Thanks to mickqian for identifying and fixing it.

The failure in both cases is `TestDcpReplayMetadata.test_replay_reuses_the_captured_gather_buffer` raising:

```text
AttributeError: 'types.SimpleNamespace' object has no attribute
'skips_prefill_metadata_on_idle_dp_rank'
```

The mocked backend does not inherit `AttentionBackend`'s `False` default for this capability. Initializing it explicitly lets the replay test reach its existing buffer-reuse assertions without changing production behavior.

| Downstream PR | Before carrying this fix | After carrying this fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #47614 | [CPU job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41292763597/job/124807422561) fails with the missing-capability `AttributeError`. | [DCP test job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41301682406/job/124833950200) reports `"file": "test/registered/unit/model_executor/test_prefill_cuda_graph_dcp.py", "passed": true`. All 20 CPU shards passed in that run. |
| #43786 | [CPU job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41303149108/job/124869681607) independently fails with the same missing-capability error. The DCP test file was identical to its main base. | Carried the same one-line fix in [`289c324`](https://github.com/Phoenix3334/sglang/commit/289c324cf5d64108e73a52580172913ec6bc7b4d). In the [new CPU shard](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41316331423/job/124877244394), a different test, `test_decode_queue_cleanup.py::TestHeldDestinationPublication::test_publishes_while_retracted_requests_wait`, fails first because its scheduler fixture lacks `tree_cache`. The suite stops before executing the scheduled DCP test, so this second run does **not** yet provide an after-fix DCP execution result. |

Both downstream copies of the corrected DCP file match this PR's source commit `be43d568ca8115e173bd4b9f5d106a3060ae1f8b` exactly (Git blob `2b48a777d18cfd2571852ec4f43e8513f706e46a`).

For the separate `tree_cache` failure, I also compared the failing test and `disaggregation/decode.py` between the CI merge `632c7f4` and its actual upstream parent `e298298`: both files are unchanged from that upstream parent. It is a separate fixture issue, not evidence that the DCP capability correction failed.

This gives two downstream reproductions of the original error and one completed passing CPU validation of the exact corrected DCP file. It does not establish that the complete downstream CI matrices are green or provide GPU DCP runtime coverage. Could you help review this small fixture correction when available?

Follow-up on the separate blocker: the missing `tree_cache` fixture is already addressed by DarkSharpness's #47758, whose [targeted CPU run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41311097837/job/124861547391) passed 12 tests. I have carried that independent fixture correction into #43786 as `fddd180`; [its next CI run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41317407949) was blocked by the 120-minute per-user cooldown before tests executed (earliest retry under the logged cooldown: 2026-11-01 16:28:02 UTC). This does not change the completed DCP passing evidence from #47614 above.

Thanks for fixing this, @mickqian! Adding some context from #45200, which @BBuf has already LGTM'd.

  That PR's `exchangeDevice` failure is fixed in 1c38e9a, and `base-a-test-cpu (12)` passes now. Its remaining `base-a-test-cpu (16)` failure is `test_prefill_cuda_graph_dcp.py`, the same test this PR fixes. Main's scheduled run fails that shard
  too, so #45200 is waiting on this one. I'll update that branch once this lands.

  Separately, `stage-b-test-large-8-gpu-mi35x-disaggregation-amd` also failed on #45200 after merging main, though it passed on 1c38e9a. It looks intermittent: other recent PRs show both passes and failures on this job, including this one.

detail.title: [Fix] tests: Initialize DCP replay backend capability

files.patch:
@@ -103,6 +103,7 @@ def plan(*args):
             return _metadata(num_tokens=5)
 
         attn_backend = SimpleNamespace(
+            skips_prefill_metadata_on_idle_dp_rank=False,
             req_to_token_pool=SimpleNamespace(req_to_token=torch.zeros((1, 8))),
             token_to_kv_pool=SimpleNamespace(
                 get_kv_buffer_shape=lambda: (torch.Size([64, 1, 6]), None)
